main_text.l: quod ipsâ tractatione usus pullulare poterit,
rimari. Quo facto, me præter rationem animi
cognoscetis. Cæterum faxit Deus Opt. max. ut
quod hîc probè cœptum est, ulteriori ἀχει\u00dfεία
postmodum absolvi possit. Valete V. R.

page.notes: The Greek word after "ulteriori" is printed as ἀχει\u00dfεία in the scan and is uncertain; the reading is approximate. The text "ἀχει" region is partly unclear. Scattered specks and stains on the page are not transcribed. Bottom right faint printer's/digitiser mark not transcribed.
